Author: Anomaly
Name: Eorzea Timers
Punchline: Create and track personalized timers in FFXIV.
Description: Create persistent manual and game-linked countdown timers with configurable alerts, snooze controls, and an in-game overlay.
Changelog:
Stage 8 - Linked Timer Catalog
- Added a catalog containing 37 reliable game-linked timer choices.
- Added daily, weekly, Grand Company, allowance, scheduled-content, and character-activity timers.
- Added Ocean Fishing, GATE, regional Jumbo Cactpot, Fashion Report, Island Sanctuary, and Cosmic Exploration schedules.
- Added live game-data timers for maps, leves, Challenge Log, Custom Deliveries, Wondrous Tails, squadrons, retainers, island granaries, and FC voyages.
- Moved linked phase text into toggleable generated overlay notes for compact timer rows.
- Unavailable live sources are clearly labeled instead of guessed.
- Fixed nullable warnings in the completion alert window.
